notes: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published by PlayStation and reported by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 28 trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned. Every trophy is offline and single-player; there are no online trophies. Only one trophy is possibly missable (Positive Mental Attitude, in Chapter 1). Guides are written in our own words from the sources below; where no published method exists yet, the guide says so honestly.

roadmap.blurb: Play the five chapters in order. Every story trophy pops from the main missions, and nothing in the story is missable — except one meditation in Chapter 1. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter: there is no mission replay. Keep cheats off; they disable trophies and saving.
roadmap.title: Play the story

roadmap.blurb: Finish the stranger questlines: Andy (Lucia only), Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus Bret's hunting quests and 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. All of them stay available in free-roam after the story.
roadmap.title: Strangers & side quests

roadmap.blurb: Work through the nine activity types, the 42 shooting-range gold medals, the 14 drone-race locations, 20 race wins, fishing with Cal, one arcade game, all 18 meditation spots, 250 stunts and 50 challenges. Most of these count toward the 100% checklist too.
roadmap.title: Activities

roadmap.blurb: Complete 3 card sets, scan 100 WAiNK spots, discover 100 vehicles, unfog all 52 areas of Leonida, and buy the 8 purchasable garages. Scan every new vehicle and study every new animal as you go — the 100% checklist wants 200 vehicles and 100 animals.
roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration

roadmap.blurb: Robberies and wanted-level tricks: 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store in stealth, one illegal operation per gang, and the money goals — $250,000 of marked bills laundered and $100,000 spent. Bring your partner for the partner trophies.
roadmap.title: Money & crime

roadmap.blurb: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and clear what is left: 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, and every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. The five unsolved hidden trophies go here too — check their sources for updates as players crack them.
roadmap.title: 100% & platinum

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty, with the 100% checklist as the longest grind. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter, since there is no mission replay, and keep cheats off — they disable trophies and saving.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed. PowerPyx lists it as the first story trophy, unlocked right after the opening mission.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins. Story trophies unlock by playing the main missions in order, and no side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2; it pops as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. Like the other chapter trophies it is automatic and cannot be missed — just keep playing the pink-icon main missions.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Automatic story progress — no special action is required.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4; it pops after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero. That mission also leads into the finale, so keep playing the main story and it comes on its own.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission, Starting From Zero. It pops with the credits and is the second gold trophy in the set. After the story you keep free-roam, so the cleanup can start right away.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during that mission, so just play the main story through Chapter 2. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops during that mission. No preparation is needed — story progress only.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. Automatic story trophy; it pops as the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. Story progress only — it pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic; just play the mission through to the end.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the mission-named story trophies, so it pops late in the game. Story progress only.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. It is closer to 60% true completion — you need 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, and all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. The hardest trophy in the set, per PowerPyx.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-bridge flights are the quickest to farm. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. Note the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types you have done. You will meet most of them naturally while working on the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. The medals are not too hard, per PowerPyx, and the ranges also raise your Focus level. PowerPyx has a separate guide to all 12 locations and all 42 gold medals.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, since each location hosts several. The same races count toward the 100% checklist, which wants all 42. PowerPyx lists all 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many to choose from — pick the short, easy ones first. Race wins also count toward the Master of None activity types.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing location marked with a purple map icon — follow his fishing questline and beat him at it. It unlocks through the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels of any one game — you do not need to beat every challenge in it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is Lucia-only and gets marked in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Finish her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline is marked in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams (Work for Kenton); look for the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — use the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring the finds back. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, so nothing is missable; track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete are confirmed, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. All of them are still available in free-roam after the story; the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His questline, Randy's Wish List, starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered — track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List and look for the green RK icon in west Vice City. Cars he marks appear in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, and the list can be finished after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, with purple markers for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy enough labs in Take Out Kitty Litter and Tyrone gives you the second quest, Spin On This. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations, tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts double. THIS IS THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning — follow her to the balcony and accept. That meditation disappears after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx has not confirmed whether it is required, so do it while you can. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason (Jason only) and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He gives you the hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, then marks hunting spots with purple icons — bring the animals he requests back to him. He has 15 Target Decks, all needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally along the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — there are 18 sets in total. PowerPyx has a guide to all 18 set locations. You only need three sets for the trophy, so pick the easiest ones first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — scan objects in the world by holding Up then R1. There are far more than 100: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. Any 100 count, so scan whatever you pass.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — there are 80 in total, so you can skip the hardest 30. Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; the 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. You can only do it after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner with hold Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing carnage, then escape: the easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter loses sight of you. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission, which always triggers 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Keep the flashing red/blue wanted level (not the red heat level), wear an armored vest, and bring sticky bombs plus Zombix or Adrenaline. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) — rob a couple of items in each, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and keep going to a 4th shop if the trophy has not popped about 30 seconds after the 3rd.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app — hold Up to open it, then hold R1 to scan vehicles as they pass on a busy road. Scanning is enough; you never need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles in the game, and the 100% checklist wants 200 scanned, so this pops on the way. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming — it slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a shower, take Adrenaline to extend it, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Aim at gang members at illegal operations: it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting-range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — the easiest is at terminals E3/E4. Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km away from the airport. Planes parked on the open airfield do not count; it must be one connected to a boarding bridge.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry-store robberies. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it — that keeps the alarm silent — then find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his two Payday Loans jobs) to find more vaults. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops on the way; each pays up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults counts — tailing the truck to a bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing the truck. Or do it earlier: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door, and escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map, covering all 52 named areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the map is clear. PowerPyx has a guide to unfogging the map fast.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total; one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so this pops on the way. They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and you can track each gang under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No published method exists yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and the exact trigger has not been pinned down. Check the source link for updates as players crack it; do not trust unverified steps.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No published method exists yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. Check the source link for updates; the trigger is still being confirmed by players.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — by stealing all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn. Buy sticky bombs first, then grab the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and blow the safe in the north-east hallway office. The trophy pops after you escape the police. It is not missable: the robbery icon respawns, so you can come back for any valuables you missed.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — max out Strength on both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You can only do it after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Work out together — call your partner and train at a fitness club (filter Map > Activities) or at home after the story — while one trains, the other progresses too.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count. Turn on notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes and fights all count, and it happens passively while you work on the other trophies. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile — it makes police far more aggressive.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No published method exists yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Check the source link for updates; do not trust unverified steps.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No published method exists yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. Check the source link for updates as players work it out.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. No published method exists yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Check the source link for updates; the exact trigger is still unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative across all robberies; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — they are the most expensive. The city has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and more, so normal shopping on the way to the other trophies covers most of it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 purchasable garages (plus 4 story garages that do not count), $160,000 in total. They unlock after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. Buy them through the app; robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the fastest way to fund them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need garage parking first — each garage adds spots — then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap cars and bikes to keep the cost down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
